summary: P0 multi-tenant retest after the iteration-10 fixes. Backend: the regression suite test_multitenant.py passes 21/21 (after updating one test for the scoped counter key). The new test_tenancy.py passes 7/10. UI: all requested flows checked with Playwright. All iteration-10 P0 items are now fixed and confirmed. (a) settings, rar_autopass_config and efactura_config exist separately for 2 branches of the same tenant. There is no collision, and each branch's values persist when switching back. (b) Counters use the key tenant:branch:name. The first work order in each of 3 TEST branches got number 00001, and the demo counter did not change. (c) The unique indexes are compound tenant+branch. The same VIN and product code are accepted in another tenant. A duplicate inside the same branch is rejected with 400/409. (d) A non-superadmin gets 403 on PUT and DELETE of a SUPERADMIN user, and the password hash stays unchanged. A demo admin's no-op PUT on the real owner also gets 403. Cross-tenant user management gets 404. All /platform endpoints return 403 for non-superadmins, and the quota does not change. (e) The e-Factura cron (tokens/status/inbox) and the reminders cron answer 200 immediately (<5s). They return 401 without the secret, and a repeated X-Webhook-Id is reported as duplicate. A reminder notification was created in BOTH branches of tenant Q2, each with the correct tenant/branch. No new 'Context tenant lipsă' or traceback appeared in the backend log. (f) Quota: a tenant with quota 1 gets 403 on its 2nd branch, and quota 2 gets 403 on its 3rd. (g) Cross-tenant access by id fails closed for clients, vehicles, work orders, invoices (including storno and from-work-order), products, appointments, warranty claims, payments and NIRs. The demo documents are byte-identical before and after. Lists and aggregations for the TEST tenant are empty or zero: 18 list endpoints, the dashboard, the final-inspections report, cash-register and expirations. Branch B of the same tenant cannot read branch A records. (h) Migration: 0 unscoped documents across the 29 operational collections and no unclassified collections. (i) The public quote and the active-branch switch were rechecked in the regression suite. UI: after login the branches load without a reload. The selector appears for a user with more than one branch, on desktop and on mobile (390px). Switching reloads the page, and the Clients list changes strictly per branch with no stale data. The owner (SUPERADMIN) sees no selector (1 branch) and sees the platform panel. The demo admin has no platform link and gets 'Acces rezervat Superadmin.' NEW issues: (1) GET /api/efactura/oauth/callback has no tenant scope and returns 503 'Context tenant lipsă', so the ANAF OAuth connection cannot finish. (2) A SUSPENDED tenant keeps full access: an existing token gets 200 and a new login also gets 200. (3) DELETE /clients/{id} of another tenant returns 200 {ok:true} instead of 404. No data is deleted, but an audit entry is written. GET /products/{foreign}/moves returns 200 with an empty result instead of 404. (4) On mobile with the selector shown, the header overflows (scrollWidth 414 > 390), so the logout button and theme toggle are partly off-screen. All TEST data was removed: tenants, branches, users, operational documents, audit logs, notifications, counters and cron_runs. The UI fixture was cleaned up. The demo data is intact.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated ANAF redirect that never sets a tenant scope. ef.get_cfg() goes through the scoped proxy and returns 503 'Context tenant lipsă', so the OAuth flow can never complete for any tenant. Fix: look up the tenant/branch with raw_db.efactura_config.find_one({'kind':'efactura','oauth_state':state}), then set_scope(tenant_id, branch_id) before get_cfg/exchange_code. If the state is unknown, redirect with ?oauth=error.

Tenant status is never checked. After PUT /platform/tenants/{id} status=SUSPENDED, the tenant user's existing token still gets 200 on /clients and a new login also gets 200. Plan suspension and expiry are therefore not enforced. The active branch status is not checked either.

minor.issue: When the client belongs to another tenant or branch, the endpoint returns 200 {ok:true} and writes an audit log. Data stays isolated (delete_one is scoped), but it should check existence and return 404.
For a product of another tenant it returns 200 {moves:[],lots:[]} instead of 404. No data leaks.
Only HTTPException is caught inside _run_job. Any other exception in one branch stops the loop for all remaining branches. Wrap each branch iteration in try/except and log it.
Does not check user.active or the tenant status before issuing new cookies.

There is still no API or UI for a SUPERADMIN to create a tenant's first TENANT_ADMIN or to assign users to several branches. Tests seed users through Mongo. There is also no UI to edit a tenant's quota or status (PUT exists only in the API).

ui_bugs.issue: The header overflows to scrollWidth 414 (489 on the dashboard). logout-button sits at x=414, off-screen, and the theme toggle is cut. Hide the date or language buttons on small screens, shrink 'Recepție nouă' to an icon, or move the selector into the Sheet menu.

action_items: HIGH: Resolve the tenant scope in /efactura/oauth/callback from oauth_state with raw_db, then set_scope; currently 503.
HIGH: Enforce tenant.status == ACTIVE (and branch ACTIVE) in get_current_user, login and refresh; a SUSPENDED/EXPIRED tenant must get 403.
MEDIUM (FE): Fix the mobile header overflow when the branch selector is shown (logout button off-screen).
MINOR: Return 404 on DELETE /clients/{id} and GET /products/{id}/moves when the record is out of scope; skip the audit write.
MINOR: Isolate per-branch failures in the cron loops with try/except.
MEDIUM: Add superadmin APIs/UI to create a tenant's first admin, assign users to multiple branches, and edit tenant status/quota from the panel.
critical_code_review_comments: core.TenantCollection.__getattr__ still forwards unwrapped methods (replace_one, find_one_and_delete, bulk_write, estimated_document_count) to the raw collection without a scope filter. Raise for any method that is not explicitly wrapped (fail-closed).

Raw update_one/update_many in the proxy do not strip tenant_id/branch_id from $set. A route that passes a raw body dict could move documents across tenants. write_settings strips them, but other dict-based updates should be checked.

In core._scope_filter, the system_scope bypass requires platform_role SUPERADMIN. The crons set system_scope without platform_role, so they stay correctly scoped. Keep it that way, or remove the bypass entirely if it is unused.
The access token is stored in localStorage (erp_token) as well as the httpOnly cookie, so it is exposed to XSS. Consider relying on cookies only.
Legacy unprefixed counters (work_order, invoice, ...) remain in the counters collection. They are harmless but could be removed after the migration.

rca of the issue: OAuth callback: oauth_callback has no Depends(get_current_user), so set_scope is never called and TenantCollection._scope_filter raises 503. Reproduce: curl '$URL/api/efactura/oauth/callback?code=x&state=y' gives 503. Suspended tenant: get_current_user only validates the user doc and assigned_branch_ids, and never reads tenants.status or branches.status.
